data.description: This ring is made of red gold with a single ruby cut into a pentagon shape. It functions as a ring of protection +1. In addition, the wearer may use Arcane Mark at will, but only on objects and willing creatures. Once per day, the wearer may use Wrath.
data.name: Profane Seal Signet

raw_tokens.value: Profane Seal Signet|TIMES=ATWILL|CASTERLEVEL=5|Arcane Mark (Profane Seal Signet)

This ring is made of red gold with a single ruby cut into a pentagon shape. It functions as a ring of protection +1. In addition, the wearer may use Arcane Mark at will, but only on objects and willing creatures. Once per day, the wearer may use Wrath.
